#note: A logogram @akk{KI.GUB} for @i{tallaktu} is not attested (see @bib{RN680@no. 737}, @bib{RN2720@1310-1311}, @bib{RN2721@T, 97-99}). The reading @i{tallaktu} of the previous editions appears to be based only on a vaguely similar line from Esarhaddon’s inscriptions cited in @bib{RN432@295}: @akk{šarru ša₂ tal-lak-ta-šu₂ a-bu-bu-um-ma ep-še-ta-šu₂ [la]b-bu na-ad-ru}.
